issues.description: The audit source requires a prepared tocurdtoUSD multiplier merged on datadate/curcd. The complete local daily/monthly rate schemas do not contain that target field; no source establishes rate direction, frequency/date choice or the exact conversion transformation. Request the original WRDS conversion file or an author-confirmed construction.

The audit code requires an author-prepared exchg-to-country helper with ExchCountry and ExchCountryUpper fields, and the datasheet says the U.S.-exchange classifications were manually created. The helper/codebook is not included; request the exact mapping and its coverage.

The audit code consumes a prepared North America sic field and describes it as Worldscope SIC code 1 based on the segment industry contributing most to revenue/net sales. A local raw Worldscope COMPANY component is confirmed: ITEM7021 is labeled SIC CODE 1 and the readable header includes Year_ and Worldscope/CUSIP/ISIN/PermID identifiers. The Worldscope schema has no GVKEY, and the supplied do-file does not show the field producer or historical mapping into the appended North America GVKEY-year panel. The distinct TRWS.WRDS_WS_SEGMENTS ITEM19506 product-segment SIC field is not established as the same measure; Compustat SICH is historical, and COMP.COMPANY.sic is a separate current-SIC field. The author-prepared SIC1 construction and its GVKEY/history bridge therefore remain unresolved.

The audit code separately imports Additional Analyses.xlsx and uses PCAOB_Access_Year, IFRS_fyear, Concurrent_PCAOBEst and Concurrent_IFRSEst. This second workbook is not packaged. Request the exact sheet and fields; PCAOB_Joint is hard-coded and should not be added to the workbook contract.

The wide News workbook is a separate required input and is available only by author request in the datasheet. The package does not contain it, so exact headers, country/year counts and the 2000-2020 news series used for four lags cannot yet be staged. Request the prepared workbook or an author-approved equivalent.

The audit source identifies its RULE_OF_LAW input as part of the May 20, 2021 prepared snapshot, and the supplied code consumes RL.EST. Current public WGI is available, but the official 2026 release recalculated historical estimates; the supplied evidence does not establish whether the source-documented 2021 WGI measure/method and history correspond to that current version. Keep this specific original WGI measurement/history match unresolved; it is not a public-data availability finding.

The hazard source explicitly uses original April 14, 2021 WGI files and notes methodology changes. The official 2026 WGI release recalculated historical estimates. Current public series are a supported access route, but exact author-version values for Rule of Law and Regulatory Quality estimates/ranks remain unverified; request the original files or approval to substitute current data.

actions.description: Stage the compatible local Compustat Global and North America annual records in the author-required Stata format.
steps: Export the bounded, catalog-listed COMP.G_FUNDA and COMP.FUNDA products with the matched identity, date, currency, audit, industry-history and financial fields into separate Stata inputs.
Append the two inputs in the source-prescribed order and retain the 1998-1999 construction history before restricting the analysis to 2000-2019.
Do not treat the packaged gvkey-date identifier list as a replacement for the full firm-year panel.
validation: Confirm exported columns and types against the source field matrix, then validate the author-documented 1998-2020 period and the 2000-2019 analysis sample during staging.

actions.description: Obtain the exact author currency-conversion input or its confirmed construction before building USD assets and sales.
steps: Request the WRDS file or documented rate rule that yields tocurdtoUSD on datadate and curcd.
If the author confirms a COMP.G_EXRT_DLY or COMP.G_EXRT_MTH construction, document target/base currency direction, selected rate variable, date matching and conversion behavior before staging it.
Do not substitute a candidate rate file by name alone.
validation: Compare currency identifiers, dates, rate direction and resulting multiplier fields to the confirmed author contract before merging.

actions.description: Request the exchange-code-to-country helper and its mapping rules from the authors.
steps: Obtain the exact Excel helper or a codebook plus its exchange-code key.
Preserve every consumed country field ExchCountry and ExchCountryUpper1-9/Upper510, including the manual U.S.-located exchange classification.
validation: Check one-to-one exchg keys, nonmissing coverage for the firm panel and U.S.-listed/cross-listed flags before proceeding.

actions.description: Clarify the producer and identifier/history link that created the prepared North America sic field from Worldscope SIC CODE 1.
steps: Request the author-prepared producer or mapping that links Worldscope COMPANY code/Worldscope identifiers and Year_ to the appended North America GVKEY/fyear records, including the required history and selection rule.
Ask whether the intended prepared field is COMPANY.ITEM7021 (SIC CODE 1) or the distinct SEGMENTS.ITEM19506 product-segment SIC field, and how the highest-revenue/net-sales segment is selected.
Confirm the intended Compustat historical SICH fallback and do not substitute current COMP.COMPANY.sic or SICH for Worldscope SIC1 without that confirmation.
validation: Confirm the documented field, identifier bridge, segment-selection construction and firm-year history against the author-prepared panel before applying SIC_1DIGIT/SIC_2DIGIT filters.

actions.description: Stage the supplied audit POB workbook through the prescribed Stata firstrow import.
steps: Use the packaged Table 2.xlsx and the POB_Initial Characteristics sheet identified by the source.
Check that Stata imports the intended lowercase nation merge key given the raw Nation/nation pair; retain all six consumed establishment/inspection measures.
validation: Confirm the imported variable names and country-key match before merging; verify characteristic values only during staging.

actions.description: Stage the supplied Hazard inspection workbook and verify firstrow field-name translation.
steps: Import Sheet2 with the source-prescribed firstrow option.
Confirm the five embedded-linebreak raw headers become the exact underscore names consumed by the program; if not, use a documented data-preparation name map while preserving the author fields.
Keep this workbook separate from the Additional Analyses policy workbook.
validation: Check all consumed country, establishment and inspection columns and the Country merge key after import.

actions.description: Request the independent country-policy workbook used by the audit-quality code.
steps: Obtain Additional Analyses.xlsx and the POB_Initial Characteristics sheet with nation, PCAOB_Access_Year, IFRS_fyear, Concurrent_PCAOBEst and Concurrent_IFRSEst.
Do not add PCAOB_Joint as an input column; the supplied program hard-codes that flag.
validation: Confirm country uniqueness, nonmissing date/flag fields and the source-prescribed nation merge before calculating policy variables.

actions.description: Request the author-prepared country-year Nexis Uni news workbook.
steps: Request the Stata Upload sheet with country, establishment, News-by-year and period-date fields used by the supplied reshape/drop sequence.
Preserve the documented 49-country 2000-2020 source range and the code's country exclusions; retain sufficient history for its four lags.
validation: Check country-year uniqueness, years, count definitions and the required lag history against the source before creating the hazard panel.

actions.description: Stage the supported audit WDI growth series and preserve only the source-specific WGI history question for RULE_OF_LAW.
steps: For GDP_annualgrowth, acquire the already supported NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG from the verified public WDI route and convert its country/year/name fields to the audit-panel keys as ordinary preparation; missing May 20, 2021 GDP file bytes or values alone do not require author approval for this compatible current measure.

For RULE_OF_LAW, retain the authored RL.EST measure and the source-documented May 20, 2021 snapshot/method context. Current public WGI is available, but its 2026 release recalculated historical estimates; seek only targeted evidence or clarification of the original WGI measure/version history if it cannot be established from the supplied materials, and do not silently equate histories or gate WDI acquisition.
validation: After WDI staging, check the series identifier, country/year coverage, and mapped audit-panel fields. Treat value/vintage comparison against the 2021 extract as later validation where reference values are available, not as an access prerequisite.
For WGI, keep the source-documented 2021 measure/method/history distinct from the 2026 recalculated estimates until the original version mapping is established.

actions.description: Stage the four already supported WDI input files using their three authored measures, while keeping the four WGI inputs’ original-version/history question as a separate conditional clarification.
steps: Acquire the four WDI inputs using the named public measures: NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG, two separate GDP-per-capita inputs both requesting NY.GDP.PCAP.KD, and CM.MKT.LDOM.NO. Convert country/year/name fields to each source-specified target as ordinary preparation; missing original bytes alone do not require author approval for these compatible public routes.

Keep the four WGI inputs separate as RL.EST, RL.PER.RNK, RQ.EST, and RQ.PER.RNK. Preserve the source-documented April 14, 2021 method/vintage evidence; current public WGI is available, but the 2026 release recalculated historical estimates. Leave exact original WGI history/measure matching unresolved and seek only targeted version/measurement clarification if needed; do not make that question a prerequisite for staging the WDI inputs.
Map each of the eight independent inputs to countrycode/year and its source-prescribed target variable, then apply only the missing-value fills documented by the supplied source.
validation: After staging, check each input’s fields, country/year keys and 2000-2020 coverage; treat ordinary WDI acquisition, name conversion and observed-value checks as preparation.

For the WGI inputs, preserve the documented 2021 method/vintage separately from the 2026 recalculated history; do not assert historical equivalence until the original series/version mapping is established.

actions.description: Acquire the official WFE Total Equity Market annual market-capitalization export and run the supplied country aggregation preparation.
steps: Register for the WFE Statistics Portal and select Equity > Total Equity Market > Market capitalisation, annual frequency, USD, for 2000-2020.
Export the exchange/year/value fields used by Prep Hazard analysis.do and run that supplied preparation before Hazard analysis.do.
Use the supplied exchange-to-country mapping and country-year sum; the supplied screenshot's listed-company-count indicator is not the requested product.
validation: Check export units, selected indicator, exchange identifiers, year coverage and the prepared country-year MarketCapCountry output before merging.
Follow WFE registration and reuse terms for data access, reproduction and distribution.

actions.description: Install the Stata add-ons that the supplied programs call and the successful metadata checks found unavailable.
steps: In the designated Stata 18 environment, install/configure winsor2, outreg2, distinct, asdoc, eventdd, csdid and drdid using the authors' supported Stata package source and compatible versions.
Keep the already available reghdfe/ftools and estpost/esttab installations; do not treat the available Stata interpreter alone as proof that these add-ons are installed.
validation: Confirm each add-on's availability metadata and version in the intended Stata environment before running the author programs.

actions.description: Configure a local working-copy project root and preserve the supplied producer/consumer order without publishing the private author home root.
steps: Set a local project root and route the required inputs/outputs to the workspace copy; do not copy the private author root into new files.
Run Prep Hazard analysis.do before Hazard analysis.do so the country-year WFE file exists before its merge; run Audit quality analyses.do as its separate program after all audit inputs are staged.
Preserve each matched save/use path and ensure output files are not deleted or overwritten before their first consumer.
validation: Before attempting execution, confirm each input resolves in the working copy and compare every generated producer's output destination with its first consumer.

review_notes: The scope is the complete supplied workflow only. The packaged gvkey-date identifier list is not a full analysis panel, so no analysis_only scope is claimed.

All three supplied entry programs were included. Prep Hazard analysis.do produces the WFE country-year intermediate before Hazard analysis.do consumes it; Audit quality analyses.do is a separate branch.

The value-free producer/consumer check bound each source to the byte-first screen and matched 28 supplied dependencies. The later audit save at line 352 is not the producer for the earlier line-347 use; line 340 is.

The consumed-field matrix retains complete native schemas/case and exact headers for existing readable probes. Both Compustat native schemas contain the selected common fields and sich but not sic. Daily/monthly currency candidates lack tocurdtoUSD; zero-result lookup records are not evidence of unavailability.
The packaged Table 2 and Hazard inspection workbooks are positively credited for the actual fields present. Import/case/header normalization and downstream coverage remain staging checks.

The WFE source screenshot selects a listed-company-count indicator; the operative preparation code and datasheet request Total Equity Market capitalization. The official WFE route supports that measure, so the screenshot mismatch is retained as output-fidelity context and does not change the authored input.
Both operative Hazard GDP-per-capita calls request NY.GDP.PCAP.KD. The differing current-USD comment is retained as output-fidelity context; the series is not changed to NY.GDP.PCAP.CD.

The original 2021 World Bank snapshots are distinct from current official data. WDI remains a verified public source route for the named indicators; current WGI is unverified for exact author-version values because its 2026 release recalculated historical estimates.

The first field-matrix draft and first matrix helper exception are preserved but unused. Matrix v2 explicitly models Stata name translation for the Hazard workbook; the exact imported linebreak-to-underscore names remain a staging validation.
The initial path relation helper's line-bound error and the duplicated-cwd process-creation failure are retained as unused provenance; no author file, cache, frozen artifact or source was modified.

Raw .smcl logs were left opaque. The byte-first screen withheld the Hazard connection-candidate block and contact-like appendix lines as preventive display masks; these do not establish a credential incident.
No author/model program, SAS executable, payload download, package installation or regression was run. The finalizer remains the only write to its prescribed assessment output directory.

Worldscope field assessment: the exact shared native metadata JSON was copied byte-for-byte into this generation and its SHA matched. A single row_limit=1, row_offset=0, timeout=15 probe read only selected headers for TRWS.WRDS_WS_COMPANY; it returned ITEM7021, Year_ and the selected identifier fields, with coverage unverified and no row values captured. The local COMPANY component is credited as raw-source availability, while its author-panel GVKEY/history/selection producer is unresolved.

SIC ownership remains branch-specific: COMP.G_FUNDA and COMP.FUNDA require their compatible native fields including historical SICH; the NA branch's prepared sic remains a separate Worldscope requirement. COMP.COMPANY current sic, COMP.* SICH and Worldscope COMPANY.ITEM7021 / SEGMENTS.ITEM19506 are distinct fields/products and are not silently equated.
